integrity: The embedded Python 3 checker uses exact rational arithmetic on independent reconstructions; the full infinite-horizon result is proved analytically, and finite tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for scalar pure-lag negative feedback, one step per delay interval, fresh independently uniform randomized internal stages, exact arithmetic and deterministic starting triples. Stability of adaptive meshes, almost-sure exponents, and accuracy rates is not established. Publication priority has not been independently certified.
title: A sharp mean-square stability frontier for one-cell randomized Runge–Kutta on delayed feedback
